page.title: Marbella Yacht Charter for Pride 2038: Celebration on the Water

data.meta_description: Book a marbella yacht charter pride 2038 celebration with Boat Rental Marbella. Depart from Puerto Banús from €749/2h. Inclusions: skipper, drinks, snacks, VAT.
data.summary: Celebrate Pride 2038 in style with a private yacht charter from Puerto Banús. Our fleet includes boats from €749/2h with skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT included.

faq.q: What is included in a Pride 2038 yacht charter?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden charges.

faq.q: Can I book a yacht for a Pride 2038 party?
faq.a: Yes. Our boats are ideal for celebrations. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski. Smaller groups can choose the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 from €749/2h.

faq.q: How many people can join a Pride 2038 charter?
faq.a: Maximum 12 pax on most yachts (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Ferretti 94). For smaller groups, the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are available.

faq.q: Where do Pride 2038 charters depart from?
faq.a: All yachts depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. We can arrange pickup from Marbella Marina or nearby hotels upon request.

faq.q: What is the price for a Pride 2038 yacht charter?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) from €4,719 for 4 hours. Other boats priced on request.

faq.q: Can I bring my own decorations or music?
faq.a: Absolutely. You're welcome to bring decorations, a speaker, or a playlist. Our skipper will help you find the best spots for photos and swimming.

faq.q: What is the best time for a Pride 2038 sunset cruise?
faq.a: Sunset cruises depart around 18:00–19:00 (depending on season). The golden light over La Concha and the coast is spectacular. Book early to secure your slot.

faq.q: Are there any extra costs for fuel or crew?
faq.a: No. Fuel, skipper, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT are all included in the quoted price. No surprises.

data.body_html:
Celebrate Pride 2038 in Marbella with a private yacht charter that combines luxury, freedom, and the Costa del Sol's best coastline. Depart from Puerto Banús on your own boat, with a licensed skipper, chilled drinks, and snacks included. Our fleet ranges from the compact Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) to the 24m Mangusta 80 (from €4,719/4h with a free jet ski). Whether you're planning a sunset celebration or a full-day party, we make it simple and inclusive.

Why choose a yacht charter for Pride 2038

Pride is about visibility, community, and celebration. A private yacht gives you and your group a floating space to be yourselves — away from crowded venues, with total privacy. You control the music, the itinerary, and the vibe. Anchor at Cala del Faro for a swim, cruise past the Golden Mile, or stop at Cabopino for lunch. It's your day, your way.

Our fleet for Pride 2038 charters

We have boats for every group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

For smaller groups, see our speedboat and Dubhe options (5 pax each).

What's included in your charter

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

Customise your Pride 2038 itinerary

Your skipper knows the best spots. Popular routes include:

  • Puerto Banús to Cabopino – 40 min cruise, quiet coves, beach club options.
  • Marbella to Estepona – 1 hour, with stops at Cala Cortés and Playa del Cristo.
  • Sunset around La Concha – the mountain turns pink, perfect for photos.

You can also request a jet ski (free on Mangusta 80 charters) or a paddleboard.

How to book your Pride 2038 yacht

Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing on boats not listed with fixed rates. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks ahead for Pride week. Deposit secures your slot. Balance due 7 days before departure.

Pride 2038: dates and timing

Marbella Pride 2038 runs from 1–4 June. Our yachts are available for half-day (4h) or full-day (8h) charters. Morning departures (10:00) for swimming and lunch, afternoon (14:00) for partying, or sunset (18:00) for a romantic cruise. All times are flexible.
